title.en: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
title.zh: 微软推出人工智能安全工具，称其性能优于竞争平台

summary.en: Microsoft says tools cost less than competing ones and outperform them, too.
summary.zh: 微软表示，工具的成本低于竞争对手，而且性能也优于竞争对手。

title.en: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
title.zh: 萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 表示，那些相信一种人工智能能解决所有问题的公司可能无法生存

summary.en: Companies without their own models — or without a layer of AI infrastructure known as AI gateways to separate their prompts from the model itself — will be in trouble, Nadella say…
summary.zh: 纳德拉说，没有自己的模型的公司，或者没有被称为人工智能网关的人工智能基础设施层，将其提示与模型本身分开的公司，将会遇到麻烦……

title.en: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
title.zh: PSA：您的 Claude 共享聊天记录和工件可能已出现在 Google 上

summary.en: The issue appears to have originated from Claude’s “share chat” feature, which allows users to create links that enable anyone with the assigned URL view a conversation or project.
summary.zh: 该问题似乎源于 Claude 的“共享聊天”功能，该功能允许用户创建链接，使任何拥有指定 URL 的人都可以查看对话或项目。

title.en: OpenAI called the Hugging Face attack unprecedented. But we’ve been here before.
title.zh: OpenAI 称“拥抱脸部”攻击是史无前例的。但我们以前来过这里。

title.en: Why China is giving away its best AI models
title.zh: 为什么中国要赠送最好的人工智能模型

summary.en: Silicon Valley has spent much of the past week on red alert, digesting the arrival of Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, a Chinese AI model that can allegedly beat some of the best systems bu…
summary.zh: 过去一周的大部分时间，硅谷都处于红色警报状态，消化着 Moonshot AI 的 Kimi K3 的到来，这是一种中国人工智能模型，据称可以击败一些最好的系统。

title.zh: 通往超级人工智能之路

summary.en: Imagine a healthcare system made up of multiple AI agents: one that manages symptom assessment, another scheduling, a third insurance, and a fourth pharmacy. Each is an expert in…
summary.zh: 想象一下由多个人工智能代理组成的医疗保健系统：一个负责管理症状评估，另一个负责调度，第三个保险和第四个药房。每个人都是……的专家

title.en: How AI is expanding what people do at work
title.zh: 人工智能如何扩展人们的工作范围

summary.en: New OpenAI research shows how AI is expanding what workers do, with ChatGPT users taking on tasks across roles and reshaping job boundaries.
summary.zh: 新的 OpenAI 研究表明，人工智能如何扩展员工的工作范围，让 ChatGPT 用户承担跨角色的任务并重塑工作边界。

summary.en: "Here’s a more natural, flowing version of that section..."
summary.zh: “这是该部分的更自然、流畅的版本……”

title.en: Accelerating the frontiers of scientific discovery: Google’s $40M commitment to the Genesis Mission
title.zh: 加速科学发现的前沿：Google 对创世纪任务的 4000 万美元承诺

summary.en: Google commits $40M in AI tokens and credits for the Genesis Mission
summary.zh: 谷歌承诺为创世任务投入 4000 万美元的人工智能代币和积分

title.en: Google just redesigned the search box for the first time in 25 years — here’s why it matters more than you think.
title.zh: Google 25 年来首次重新设计了搜索框——这就是为什么它比你想象的更重要。

summary.en: For a quarter century, the Google search box has been one of the most recognizable interfaces in computing: a thin white rectangle, a blinking cursor, a few typed words, and a lis…
summary.zh: 四分之一个世纪以来，谷歌搜索框一直是计算领域最知名的界面之一：一个细长的白色矩形、一个闪烁的光标、几个键入的单词和一个列表……
